text: Five Stars. Great looking. We got the matching coffe table also.

product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Marimon Black Round End Table
features: Made of a durable, textured powder coated metal in a dark wrought iron color. Tops are made of select birch veneers and finished in a vintage rub-through black finish. Design features a woven industrial basket look with wood tops. Bold rivet detail add a sense of an industrial heritage. Cocktail table has casters.
